title: Block hours from the calendar
summary: Right-click an open time → Block hours: closes that range for that day only, for the whole branch, as an exception schedule.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: In the calendar, what shows in white is open for booking.

steps.title: Right-click an open time
steps.details: On a free time, not on an appointment. The option doesn't show up on a closed band or in a doctor column.

steps.title: Block hours…
steps.details: It suggests one hour from where you clicked.

steps.title: To
steps.details: It must be after "From". Below you can see the appointments within the range and the resulting hours for the day.

steps.title: Reason
steps.details: Optional. Shown on the calendar's red band (e.g. team meeting).

steps.title: Block
steps.details: It closes the whole branch for that range that day, for the WhatsApp agent too. Existing appointments aren't touched. Undo it with right-click → Enable hours.
